strings.name: Issad Rebrab
strings.role: Cevital founder and former group leader
strings.summary: Issad Rebrab is an Algerian entrepreneur who moved from accountancy into metals and founded Cevital Group in 1998, expanding into food processing and European manufacturing investments. He handed group leadership to his son Malik in 2022. His career has also involved a criminal conviction and subsequent business restrictions.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through 17 November 2026. Birth is confirmed only to 1944; current roles, conviction, release and business restrictions are recorded separately. Recent status relies on secondary reporting.
strings.influence.rationale: Founded Cevital industrial group, developing Algerian food processing, manufacturing and international investment.
strings.facts.f1.label: Early career
strings.facts.f1.value: Studied accounting and worked as a teacher before opening an accounting practice in 1968; no specific university degree is inferred.
strings.facts.f2.label: Leadership succession
strings.facts.f2.value: Announced in June 2022 that he would retire on the 30th and be succeeded by his son Malik; the old company biography's current-chair wording is outdated.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Industry and international investment
strings.highlights.h1.text: Expanded from metals into food processing and participated in European manufacturing through transactions including Oxxo and Brandt.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Legal record and restrictions
strings.highlights.h2.text: Received an 18-month sentence in 2020, with 12 months suspended, and was then released. Business restrictions were reported in 2023; these were separate decisions.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Business restrictions reported
strings.timeline.t1.text: Media cited a document dated 23 May barring commercial and management activities; the restrictions are not described as a new criminal conviction.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Group leadership handed over
strings.timeline.t2.text: Retired under the arrangement announced on 22 June, with Malik succeeding; later reporting confirmed the June handover.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Released after sentencing
strings.timeline.t3.text: Reports described 18 months, comprising six custodial and 12 suspended. Previous detention exceeded the custodial portion; release did not mean acquittal.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Acquired Brandt's French operations
strings.timeline.t4.text: Cevital expanded its French appliance manufacturing business; this records the acquisition at the time, without implying continued ownership.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Acquired Oxxo
strings.timeline.t5.text: Expanded international industrial operations through the French window and door manufacturer.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Founded Cevital Group
strings.timeline.t6.text: Earlier food-processing operations developed into the group, distinct from his first metals venture in 1971.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Co-founded SOCOMEG
strings.timeline.t7.text: Participated in the metals manufacturing company, beginning his industrial entrepreneurship.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Opened an accounting practice
strings.timeline.t8.text: Moved from teaching into accounting services, providing a starting point for later industrial investments.
